pages.title: Survivor Girl
pages.text: §lRace: §r Human.$(br)§lAllegiance: §r Friendly.$(br)They were once Zombie Girls or Drowned Girls, healed back into people by the starlight of the Life Star.$(br)After healing, they keep their appearance, name, inventory, and equipment — and they remember the days before they were cured.$(br)§lPotions: §r Same as any human — harming potions hurt them, healing potions heal them.$(br)§lReinfection: §r If undead mobs bring their health below half, they revert to their former undead form.

pages.title: Days They Cannot Return To
pages.text: They can taste food again, feel the cold on rainy days again, and laugh out loud at a joke again.$(br)But the doors of the village are not always opened for them. Some remember the grey-white figure who dragged herself out of the fire that night; others remember only the fangs.$(br2)They rarely speak of it. They simply pick up their packs and walk on with whoever is willing to take them in.$(br2)If you hold a Life Star in your hand — remember, the moment its starlight falls, they have waited many years for it.
